input.brief:
Hand-authored clean SVG diagram showing a 1-bit Full Adder logic circuit. 
Inputs on the left: A, B, and Cin.
Intermediate gates:
- First XOR gate takes inputs A and B to produce intermediate signal (A XOR B).
- Second XOR gate takes (A XOR B) and Cin to produce final output S (Sum).
- AND gate 1 takes A and B to produce term (A AND B).
- AND gate 2 takes (A XOR B) and Cin to produce term (Cin AND (A XOR B)).
- OR gate takes the outputs of AND gate 1 and AND gate 2 to produce final output Cout (Carry-out).
Outputs on the right: S and Cout clearly labeled.
Clear signal wires, crisp labels with standard gate shapes (XOR, AND, OR), high contrast on clean background.
